## Architecture Details

### 📊 Endpoint Categories

#### 1. Main Dashboard (`/api/dashboard/`)
```
GET  /overview              - System overview data
GET  /stats                 - Quick performance stats
GET  /health                - System health status
GET  /activity              - Recent activity feed
GET  /notifications         - User notifications
POST /notifications/:id/mark-read - Mark notification read
POST /refresh               - Force data refresh
```

#### 2. Insights (`/api/dashboard/insights/`)
```
GET  /website               - Website content analysis
GET  /competitors           - Competitor intelligence
GET  /traffic               - Traffic patterns analysis
GET  /customers             - Customer segments
GET  /serp                  - SERP monitoring data
POST /website/scan          - Trigger website scan
POST /competitors/add       - Add competitor monitoring
DELETE /competitors/:id     - Remove competitor
```

#### 3. Performance (`/api/dashboard/performance/`)
```
GET  /metrics               - Performance KPIs
GET  /roi                   - ROI calculations
GET  /trends                - Historical trends
GET  /comparisons           - Period comparisons
GET  /attribution           - Marketing attribution
GET  /cohorts               - Cohort analysis
POST /goals                 - Set performance goals
GET  /export                - Export performance data
```

#### 4. Optimizations (`/api/dashboard/optimizations/`)
```
GET  /pending               - Pending optimizations
GET  /applied               - Applied optimizations
GET  /history               - Optimization history
GET  /recommendations       - AI recommendations
POST /actions/approve       - Approve optimization
POST /actions/reject        - Reject optimization
POST /actions/rollback      - Rollback optimization
POST /batch-approve         - Batch approve
GET  /impact/:id            - Impact analysis
POST /settings              - Update settings
```

### 🔒 Security & Authentication

**Authentication Middleware:**
- Shopify session validation on all routes
- Shop domain extraction for tenant isolation
- Subscription tier enforcement per endpoint

**Security Features:**
- Input validation and sanitization
- Rate limiting via response optimizer
- CORS and security headers
- Error handling without data leakage

**Subscription Tiers:**
- Basic: Core dashboard and insights
- Professional: Advanced analytics and optimizations
- Enterprise: Full feature access including cohorts

### ⚡ Performance Requirements

**Response Time Targets:**
- Cached data: <100ms
- Fresh data: <300ms
- Complex analytics: <500ms

**Caching Strategy:**
- Dashboard orchestrator caching layer
- ETags for client-side caching
- Cache hit/miss tracking in metadata

**Optimization Features:**
- Response compression via middleware
- Pagination support (limit/offset)
- Selective data inclusion via query params

### 📝 Response Format Standard

All endpoints return consistent JSON structure:
```json
{
  "success": true|false,
  "data": {},
  "metadata": {
    "timestamp": "2025-09-28T10:00:00Z",
    "cache": "HIT|MISS",
    "responseTime": 145
  }
}
```

## Deployment Readiness

### 📋 Integration Requirements

**Server.js Integration:**
```javascript
// Add to server.js after existing dashboard routes
import dashboardApiRoutes from "./routes/dashboard.js";
```
